email.title: Email
email.description: The email you use to sign in to the eWeLink app

countryCode.title: Country code
countryCode.description: Phone country code of your eWeLink account, e.g. +1 (USA), +44 (UK), +20 (Egypt), +971 (UAE)

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval
refreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh device state. Minimum 15, 0 disables polling.

lightList.description: Expose these switches (names or device IDs) as lights instead of outlets

whiteList.description: Only expose devices with these names or device IDs (empty exposes all)

blackList.description: Never expose devices with these names or device IDs

appId.title: App ID (advanced)
appId.description: Optional: your own eWeLink developer App ID from https://dev.ewelink.cc. Leave empty to use the plugin's built-in app.

appSecret.title: App Secret (advanced)
appSecret.description: Optional: the App Secret that goes with your own App ID

debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin

unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
